prerequisites: Prior knowledge of different types of productive processes, normalized representation of industrial plant structure and associated machines (covered by access profiles and complementary subjects in the first semester).

Total or partial completion of design and development work for the control and supervision system of the subject "Análisis e Implementación de Sistemas de Automatización" (Analysis and Implementation of Automation Systems), taught in the first semester.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand different industrial production processes, with the applicable technologies and standards.
Analyze and design processes using plant representation schemes, including P&ID diagrams.
Understand and apply techniques and strategies for the implementation and commissioning of plants and processes.

syllabus_topics: Types of productive processes: paper, chemical/petrochemical, steel, manufacturing, automotive, food, etc.
Productive structure. Typical technologies and applicable standards.
Configuration and installation of automation and process control applications. Practical cases.
assessment_rules: A minimum grade of 5 out of 10 is required in each of the assessed components to pass the subject. The final grade is calculated as: Final Grade = (EXT * 0.1) + (TP * 0.8) + (ASIS * 0.1). Grades obtained in each test can be carried over between different calls within the same academic year. In case of doubt regarding authorship or unauthorized means, students may be asked for a in-person defense.
bibliography: Lluis Cuatrecasas, "Ingeniería de Procesos y de Planta". Profit Editorial, 2017
ISO 3511 - UNE 1096 standards. Functions and instrumentation for the measurement and regulation of industrial processes.
UNE-EN-ISO 10628 standards. Flow diagrams for process plants. General rules.
Graphical Symbols for Process Display. ANSI/ISA-S5.5-1985 Standard
Technical information on various PLC equipment: M340 from Schneider Electric, S7 from Siemens, ILC-AXC and PLnext from Phoneix Contact, AC500 from ABB.
Help Manuals: “CoDeSys v3.5 y CoDeSys v2.3”
